title: Graph Explorer
emptyFocus: Open an object from its detail view in the Graph Explorer (or double-tap a node) to start exploring its dependency graph.
truncated: Loaded {{kept}} of {{total}} reachable nodes — lower the depth or narrow the type filter to load them all.
truncatedMinDepth: Loaded the {{kept}} most-connected of {{total}} neighbors — narrow the type filter to load a complete slice.

toolbar.fullscreenTitle: Open in the full Graph Explorer

inspect.noNeighbors: No neighbors in the current graph.

filter.groupByFileHint: Group nodes into boxes per file
filter.openDetails: Open the focus object’s detail view
filter.extendDepthHint: Extend the slider past 4 (up to the reachable max depth).
filter.loadAllHint: Load all types; deselecting a chip only hides it

typeList.empty: No objects of this type in the graph.

unconnectedHidden_one: {{count}} node not connected to the focus
unconnectedHidden_other: {{count}} nodes not connected to the focus
unconnectedToggleHint: Nodes with no path to the focus result from the type/depth filter — show or hide them

trace.exitHint: Leave the trace and open the neighborhood view of the start object
trace.explainer: Selective flow graph — the call chain up/down, the objects it actually touches, and the script triggers of entered layouts.

entryHints.layout_runtime: Triggers of the layout and its objects + button scripts as starting points

trace.upDepthHint: How many caller levels the chain is followed upward
trace.downDepthHint: How many subscript levels the chain is followed downward
trace.triggerDepthHint: How many cascade stages layout triggers may fire (0 = off)
trace.localVarsHint: Also show local $ variables of the chain scripts
trace.buttonsHint: Include button scripts of entered layouts as possible interactions
trace.interactionTriggersHint: Also let interaction events (keyboard, gestures, device buttons) fire in the cascade — they normally never fire during a script run
trace.expandUpHint: Also collect the objects touched by the caller chain
trace.emptyEntry: The chosen preset yields no seed scripts — please pick another entry path.
trace.truncated: {{kept}} of {{total}} trace nodes loaded — reduce the budgets to focus the excerpt.
trace.dynamicCalls: {{count}} dynamic script call (by name) without a static edge — the trace is a static approximation.
trace.dynamicCalls_other: {{count}} dynamic script calls (by name) without a static edge — the trace is a static approximation.
trace.actionHint: Open the flow graph (trace) from this object
trace.excludeHint: Keep the node visible but stop expanding through it (calls, touches, trigger cascade)
trace.clearExcludesHint: Remove all exclusions and fully re-expand the trace
trace.removeExcludeHint: Remove this exclusion — the node will be expanded again
trace.applyAllSuggestionsHint: Add all suggested hub nodes to the exclusion list
trace.suggestionHint: Suspected hub — trigger fan-in {{trig}}, callers {{calls}}, field touches {{touch}}. Click to exclude the node from the trace.
